question: Who was conferred Brazil's highest civilian honour, "The Grand Collar of the National Order of the Southern Cross," in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The "Grand Collar of the National Order of the Southern Cross" is the highest civilian honor awarded by Brazil to foreign dignitaries.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with this prestigious honor in recognition of his contributions to strengthening bilateral relations between India and Brazil.
